summary: Campus service lane against Schonell Theatre; no stopping signs, nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Service lane hard against campus buildings
No parked cars or pull-off room

drivers.seclusion: Walled in by Schonell Theatre and the student services buildings; busy campus core with foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow paved lane with building walls to the west; no verge or bay.
drivers.traffic: Delivery and service traffic in the campus centre, plus pedestrians.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Mon-Fri 7am-6pm and No Stopping Any Time signs; no cars parked along it.

sun_shade: Shaded by buildings for much of the day.
